archetypes.name: clone-parity
archetypes.rationale: Step 8 tmpdir prefixes must match retired byte-level Bash behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new implement clone-tag CLI and Step 8 wrappers for parity with the retired sourced helper. Focus on CLONE_TAG passthrough, logical PWD derivation, byte truncation, shell quoting, and fail-closed eval behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: retirement-inventory
archetypes.rationale: Deleted shell helpers must stay fully retired without stale references.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check the retired-script manifest, residual Bash inventory, agent-lint exclusions, and docs for consistency with the deleted optional-trailer and clone-tag files. Verify remaining references are intentional manifest entries or split retired-path fixtures. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: trailer-coverage
archetypes.rationale: Optional-trailer shell harness deletion relies on pytest parity.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the optional-trailer pytest coverage against the retired shell harness behavior. Focus on lost-key rejection, has-any behavior, duplicate preservation, octal rejection, block boundaries, and unchanged plan-size semantics. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
